interpretation: The three disorders coinciding on the same marginal count is a ~1-in-519 small-sample event (a few percent), not the ~3e-22 the PI estimated. The 3e-22 figure corresponds to demanding three pre-specified independent events to each hit one exact pre-specified value with no shared sampling support -- the wrong model. Critically, the raw ICD data show these are largely DIFFERENT patients, so no 'identical cohort' explanation is even in play. Equal marginals + different members = coincidence, confirmed by independent re-derivation.
